summary: Verified: (1) Submit-Tip modal opens correctly via header-submit-btn; (2) Tutorial tab shows exactly 3 Argentina vs Cape Verde examples with correct DE i18n strings + odds + 3 progress dots; (3) Rate Wall on home page contains exactly 2 tips (Portugal & Messi + Häcken parlay), no Argentina/Cape Verde tips.

test_results.backend_public_tips_api: GET /api/tips?status=pending returns exactly [seed-portugal-messi, seed-hacken-parlay] — no Argentina tips seeded

notes: The homepage body text contains 1 occurrence of 'argentin' outside the modal, but it is NOT a Rate Wall tip — it is the AI-analysis text of the Portugal & Messi showcase tip ('...dream Portugal vs Argentina final, Ronaldo vs Messi last dance'). This is expected and does NOT represent an Argentina vs Cape Verde tip on the wall.

On first read attempt with a short (400ms) wait, step-3 inner_text was stale (still showed step-2 content) because framer-motion's AnimatePresence exit/enter animation was in flight. After bumping the settle wait to 1200ms, step-3 rendered correctly with 'LIVE LOCK' / Asiatisch Über 2,0 / 1.85. Not a bug, just a test-timing note.
critical_code_review_comments: SubmitTipModal.jsx cleanly renders 3 tutorial examples from a TUTORIAL const with key/odds/tone — progress dots derive from array length, so future additions/removals stay in sync automatically.
seed_showcase() correctly and idempotently PURGES seed-tut-bad/banker/live from db.tips on every startup so any leftover Argentina tips from prior seeding are removed on next restart.
i18n.js has all three (bad/banker/live) tag/title/market/note keys in en, de, and el — verified visually in German.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Rate Wall now has 2 seed tips only (seed-portugal-messi, seed-hacken-parlay). Tutorial modal (data-testid=tutorial-panel) has 3 Argentina vs Cape Verde examples with keys bad/banker/live, driven by SubmitTipModal.TUTORIAL array. AnimatePresence transitions take ~600-1000ms; use ≥1000ms wait before reading tutorial-panel inner_text after clicking tutorial-next.
